unsafe_justifications: Production routing and validation code contains no unsafe operations.

The test-only object_slots helper issues ValidationProof after complete JSON object validation against its explicit any-object test schema. The payload length uses checked conversion; decoded storage and slots are empty.

The test-only nonempty-arena validator issues ValidationProof only after exact comparison with a fixed JSON object literal. The decoded arena contains the literal's two-byte UTF-8 value and the single string slot has exact bounds and scalar count.

Malformed provider-output tests mutate public ValidatedSlots fields after valid proof issuance; they do not issue invalid proofs using unsafe code. The boundary rejects changed bytes or mismatched payload and decoded lengths.

Explicit null IDs, minimum and maximum signed i64 IDs, and string IDs containing NUL and Unicode.
Ignored request-only notifications in every session phase, including closed sessions and tool method names.
Tools readiness and capability gates, case-sensitive method names, tools/list metadata, and rejection of pagination cursors.
tools/call default owned empty arguments, exact raw argument preservation, closed field sets, strict object arguments, and nested duplicate rejection.
Indistinguishable unknown and forbidden tools, exact any-role authorization, case-sensitive roles and names, and authorization revocation between route and validate_call.

Malformed manual parameter payloads, invalid UTF-8/escapes/surrogates, trailing content, and bounded messages that omit sensitive input.
